ITEM 1 | Two rectangular pizza-like slices with thin, bready golden-brown crust edges, topped with pale melted cheese, red-brown tomato-colored sauce, scattered dark brown crumbled pieces, and thin purple-red onion slivers; slices are about 9 cm long and 4 cm wide each, cut edge visible at the bottom, sitting on the left side of the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Mixed green salad leaves in loose heap, bright and dark green with pale ribbons, scattered shreds of orange carrot, sliced cucumber-like pale green rounds, and dark purple-brown leafy bits; moist and slightly glossy, mounded about 5 cm tall, covering the center-right of the plate | 90
ITEM 3 | Cubed cooked chicken pieces, off-white to pale golden with light browning on edges, roughly 1.5 cm cubes, irregular cut, slightly moist surface, piled on the right side of the plate next to the salad | 85
ITEM 4 | Whole dark purple-black olives, glossy and smooth, about 1.5 cm each, scattered in a small cluster at the bottom center of the plate beside the chicken and pizza | 30
ITEM 5 | Triangular dark brown crisp wafer or cracker piece with a speckled, granular top surface, about 5 cm on each side, thin and rigid, resting at the upper right edge of the salad | 8
ITEM 6 | Thin pale dressing or oil sheen, barely visible, glossy film on the salad leaves and plate surface near the greens | 5
